note: Starter taxonomy for a hackathon-scale run. Extend by adding more objects with the same shape.

techniques.description: Fraudster assembles a new identity from real+fake data fragments to pass onboarding checks.
Reused leaked credentials tried across many accounts to find valid logins.
Legitimate-looking accounts recruited to receive and forward illicit funds.
Attacker fakes device fingerprint and geolocation to bypass device-trust checks.
AI-generated face/voice used to pass liveness or biometric KYC verification.

techniques.sub_technique: Layered transfer chain across multiple mule accounts
techniques.description: Funds moved rapidly across a chain of accounts to obscure origin before cash-out.

techniques.sub_technique: Stolen card testing via low-value probes
techniques.description: Small test transactions run against stolen card numbers to validate before a large charge.

techniques.sub_technique: Repeated refund claims across linked accounts
techniques.description: Same actor exploits refund or promo mechanisms across multiple synthetic identities.

techniques.sub_technique: Friendly fraud dispute after legitimate delivery
techniques.description: Legitimate purchase disputed as unauthorized after goods/services are received.
Transactions deliberately paced/sized to stay under velocity and amount detection thresholds.
Tooling used to prevent a device fingerprint from being captured at all (MNAR missingness signal).
A merchant account colludes with fraudster accounts to process fake or laundered transactions.
AI-generated messages/remarks used to trick a victim into authorizing a fraudulent payment.
